items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launches, public beta, security-sensitive releases, alert expansion, affiliate expansion, and advertising expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; security and operations evidence is unavailable; analytics quality is yellow; Amazon evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate results of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 unattributed commission. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, authorize no new spend or monetization expansion, admit no new queue work, and keep private or parked launch gates in place until evidence and owner decisions are complete.

SearchWoot is blocked for public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict the proposed use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.
